faqs.question: What happens on the free consultation call?
faqs.answer: Thirty minutes with the specialist for your market. We map the structure, the licence class and a realistic timeline, then follow up in writing with a clear scope and clear pricing. No obligation.

faqs.question: What does it take to register a company in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Foreign investors need a MISA (Ministry of Investment) investment license, commercial registration with the Ministry of Commerce, and the right entity structure — typically an LLC, branch or representative office. Sinai Spark Global manages the full process, including document preparation, attestation and government submission.

faqs.question: How long does company formation in Saudi Arabia usually take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on entity type and activity, but most formations complete within a few weeks once documents are in order. We give you a realistic timeline at the free consultation and track every milestone for you.

faqs.question: Which Saudi license types exist, and which one do I need?
faqs.answer: Saudi Arabia issues several distinct license types depending on business activity: Commercial, Industrial, Entrepreneurial, Service and Real Estate licenses. Picking the wrong category costs time later, so we assess your activity first. See our licensing pages for details on each.

faqs.question: Can I own 100% of my Saudi company as a foreign investor?
faqs.answer: In many sectors, yes — full foreign ownership is available, notably under the industrial license. The right structure is confirmed during your consultation based on your specific activity.

faqs.question: What are PRO services, and do I need them?
faqs.answer: PRO (Public Relations Officer) services mean ongoing government liaison: work visa processing, labor documentation and Ministry paperwork. If you employ staff in Saudi Arabia, keeping these current is mandatory — this is exactly what our PRO & Visa service handles.

faqs.question: What happens after my company is formed?
faqs.answer: Formation is a one-time event; staying compliant is not. Our compliance service tracks renewal dates, filing deadlines and regulatory changes so nothing is missed after launch.

faqs.question: Do you operate outside Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sinai Spark Global is a global business setup partner with active operations across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the UK, India and Bahrain. Saudi Arabia remains our flagship and most detailed practice.

faqs.question: Can an NRI living in Saudi Arabia register a company in India?
faqs.answer: Yes. NRIs are fully eligible to incorporate a company in India, and the entire process can be completed online without visiting India.

faqs.question: How long does registration take?
faqs.answer: A Private Limited Company typically takes 7 to 10 working days once all documents are submitted.

faqs.question: What documents does an NRI need?
faqs.answer: A passport, OCI or PIO card, overseas address proof, and Indian address proof if available. A full personalized checklist is provided after the free consultation.

faqs.question: Private Limited Company or LLP, which is right for me?
faqs.answer: A Private Limited Company suits businesses planning to raise investment and scale quickly. An LLP suits professionals and small partnerships with lower compliance needs.

faqs.question: Is GST registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: GST registration is required once annual turnover crosses 20 lakh rupees, or 10 lakh in special category states, or for businesses selling goods or services online.

faqs.question: Can a Saudi national or company hold shares in an Indian company?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to FDI guidelines under FEMA. Most sectors permit full FDI, and the right structure is confirmed during the free consultation.

faqs.question: Does Sinai Spark Global India handle ongoing compliance after registration?
faqs.answer: Yes. ROC compliance, annual filings, GST filings and director KYC updates are all handled on an ongoing basis.
